newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan passes on tender for 68,000T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan passes on tender for 68,000T U.S. wheat.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association on Tuesday passed on a tender for two 34,000-tonne U.S. wheat shipments due to high prices, traders said.
The shipments would have contained Dark Northern Spring (DNS), Hard Red Winter (HRW) and White Wheat (WW) and would have been slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest.
The flour association said it was reluctant to buy wheat on a day when world wheat prices had hit a seven-month high in Asia trade, extending Chicago's overnight gains.
"It's hard to buy it when it just jumped up to US$4.2 from $3.70 per bushel," an association official said.
Traders said the association was likely to retender for the two shipments next week.
